name: Ichinose Miho
source:
A childhood friend who grew up with Kazuya.
They are currently in a romantic relationship. She graduated from a local community college a short while ago.
She lost her father when she was young and her mother while she was still in school.
Ever since then, she has been cared for by an elderly relative who is an influential figure in the community, and while she remains grateful to him, she has no intention of conforming to traditional customs.
She feels a deep attachment to this land, which holds memories of her parents.
Kazuya is the only man she has ever been with.
